data.name: Marble
data.pathway_secondary: DAC; Ocean CDR; Enhanced Weathering; Mineralization
data.description: Marble is a Paris-based climate-tech venture studio founded in 2021 by Benjamin Tincq and Jonny Everett. It partners with scientists and engineers as Founders-in-Residence to create deeptech startups across CDR pathways (DAC, ocean carbon removal, biotech CDR, geochemical/mineralization) and other climate areas, providing pre-seed funding (~€250k) and support. It is a venture builder/investor in the CDR ecosystem, not a CO2-removal operator itself.
